title: Spatial State, History, Era & Event Change
objective: Project governed Event-driven changes to routes, structures, access, migration, sanctuaries, research sites and spatial availability across eras while preserving historical state and canonical owner authority without creating duplicate World, Event or spatial-state ledgers.

persistence.reason: SSA-08 adds bounded Event-linked historical projections over existing canonical identities and does not create a durable World, Event, history or spatial-state ledger.

preserved_boundaries: SSA-01 through SSA-07 remain completed_verified with retired implementation authority.

World/Reality and Event owners remain authoritative for live and historical state; Scene, MAI, ISE, Exploration, Research, Creature ecology, Project, Permission/entitlement and provider/media-rights remain canonical.
Event-linked spatial projections cannot silently mutate canonical owner state, erase history or become a second World/Event ledger.
Geometry, semantic structure, topology, historical state and live owner state remain distinct.
Functional-zone, route, migration and sanctuary changes cannot replace Creature ecology, World/Reality, Exploration or Research authority.
Research-site changes cannot replace Research progression, Project, credential/access-control, hazard or information ownership.
Hidden/GM-only spatial history and protected cardinality remain filtered before projection.
Consequential era/state changes require accessible nonvisual representation.
No durable SSA-08 persistence change is required and migration 0022 remains unreserved.
SSA-09+, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
